hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: Conflict over Poland's Constitutional Tribunal (TK) has intensified as President Karol Nawrocki directly confronts Prime Minister Donald Tusk, accusing the government of illegal state actions and constitutional breaches. Meanwhile, PiS leader Jarosław Kaczyński fiercely condemned police actions against political allies, framing the government's measures as authoritarian aggression.
hotspots.affect: The confrontation carries severe legal and moral stakes, with right-wing outlets framing Tusk's governance as an ongoing illegal coup and constitutional emergency.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: The legal fallout surrounding Senator Flávio Bolsonaro reached a fever pitch following his flight to Florida amid an ongoing Supreme Federal Court (STF) money laundering investigation. Bolsonarista figures and defense lawyers are mounting urgent appeals against Minister Alexandre de Moraes, demanding passport recovery and Moraes' recusal.
hotspots.affect: High emotional charge driven by right-wing narratives of political exile, judicial tyranny, and an ongoing fight against the STF.

hotspots.title: Urda Train Disaster & Spanish Right Poll Surge
hotspots.blurb: Following the tragic Urda railway crash that claimed 116 lives, Vox and the Partido Popular have launched scathing attacks against Transport Minister Óscar Puente, demanding his immediate resignation and criminal trial. Right-wing coverage highlights new polling showing PP and Vox surging to an absolute majority of over 200 seats as anger mounts against the ruling PSOE.
hotspots.affect: The disaster is heavily politicized with intense affective charge, combining moral outrage over government failure with triumphant electoral momentum.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen and Rassemblement National dominate French political coverage as fresh polling places Le Pen in the lead for the 2027 presidential race. Coverage focuses on RN's growing appeal among youth and former Macron voters, while right-wing outlets aggressively push back against left-wing calls to censor CNews and threats targeted at Jordan Bardella.
hotspots.affect: Commands disproportionate focus by blending strong 2027 presidential momentum with intense grievance over media censorship and political hostility.

hotspots.title: Nigel Farage MP Altercation Row & Reform Campaign
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK faces major media focus following news that Hampshire party leader and councillor George Madgwick has been charged with 35 criminal offences, including 12 counts of rape. Concurrently, Nigel Farage and senior party figures maintain aggressive anti-immigration messaging around revoking migrant citizenship while responding to warnings from the Equalities watchdog.
hotspots.affect: High affective investment driven by serious criminal allegations against a party figure alongside combative, polarized rhetoric from national campaign leaders.
